zh.title: Tracep Congo Aviation 貨機墜毀 Walikale
zh.summary: Tracep Congo Aviation 的 LET L-410 貨機於 7 月 24 日星期五自貝尼 Mavivi 機場起飛，載運近兩噸貨物前往 Schabunda  territorio 的 Kachungu，起飛不久機長報告左引擎故障並試圖改降 Walikale 機場，隨後失聯。搜索於週末展開，副駕駛於星期天在 crash 區域被發現生還，機長則不幸罹難。事故原因仍在調查中。
body: Tracep Congo Aviation 的 LET L-410 貨機在尋獲後被證實在位於 Walikale 附近的森林區域墜毀，機上兩名機組員中一人生還、一人死亡。
該機於星期五當地時間 12：36 從貝尼 Mavivi 機場起飛，載運約兩噸貨物前往 Schabunda  territorio 的 Kachungu。
起飛不久，機長報告左引擎出現故障，並試圖改向 Walikale 機場降落，隨後失去無線電聯絡。
搜索行動於週末展開，根據 Tracep Congo Aviation 來源，副駕駛在星期天於墜機區域被發現生還，而機長則不幸罹難。
Shabunda 當地 autorités 局表示，飛機原預定抵達 Tchonka-Lulingu 但未到達，並證實在機長報告引擎問題約二十分鐘後，機組人員即成為無法聯絡的狀態。

en.title: Tracep Congo Aviation Cargo Plane Crashes in Walikale Forest, One Crew Dead, One Injured
en.summary: Tracep Congo Aviation's LET L-410 cargo aircraft departed Beni's Mavivi airport on Friday at 12:36 local time carrying nearly two tons of cargo bound for Kachungu in Shabunda territory. Shortly after takeoff the captain reported an engine failure and attempted to divert to Walikale airfield before losing radio contact. The plane was found crashed in a forest near Walikale with one survivor and one fatality among the two crew members. Search operations began Friday; the co-pilot was found alive Sunday in the crash zone while the captain died. Local authorities said the aircraft was expected at Tchonka-Lulingu but never arrived, and confirmed that after reporting an engine problem about twenty minutes after takeoff from Beni, the crew became unreachable. The cause of the accident remains under investigation.
body: The Tracep Congo Aviation LET L-410 cargo aircraft was found crashed in a forest area near Walikale with one survivor and one fatality among the two crew members.
The aircraft departed from Mavivi airport in Beni at 12:36 local time on Friday, carrying nearly two tons of cargo bound for Kachungu in Shabunda territory.
Shortly after takeoff, the captain reported an engine failure on one of the two engines and attempted to divert to Walikale airfield before losing radio contact.
Search operations were launched on Friday; according to Tracep Congo Aviation sources, the co-pilot was found alive Sunday in the crash zone while the captain died.

Local authorities in Shabunda said the aircraft was expected at Tchonka-Lulingu but never arrived, and confirmed that after reporting an engine problem about twenty minutes after takeoff from Beni, the crew became unreachable. The cause of the accident remains under investigation.

sources.name: actualite.cd — Un avion-cargo porté disparu retrouvé écrasé dans une zone…

facts.claim: A Tracep Congo Aviation LET L-410 cargo aircraft that had been missing since Friday on a flight between Beni and Shabunda territory was found crashed in a forest area near Walikale with one survivor and one fatality among the two crew members.
facts.sourceQuote: Un avion-cargo de la compagnie Tracep Congo Aviation, porté disparu depuis vendredi lors d'un vol entre Beni, dans l'est de la RDC, et le territoire de Shabunda, a été retrouvé écrasé dans une zone forestière à Walikale avec un survivant et un mort parmi les deux membres d'équipage, selon des sources concordantes.

facts.claim: The aircraft departed from Mavivi airport in Beni at 12:36 local time on Friday carrying nearly two tons of cargo bound for Kachungu in Shabunda territory.
facts.sourceQuote: L'appareil, un LET L-410, avait décollé vendredi à 12h36, heure locale, de l'aéroport de Mavivi, à Beni (Nord-Kivu), avec près de deux tonnes de marchandises à destination de Kachungu, dans le territoire de Shabunda (Sud-Kivu), selon des sources de la compagnie et de la Régie des voies aériennes (RVA).

facts.claim: Shortly after takeoff, the captain reported an engine failure on one of the two engines and attempted to divert to Walikale airfield before losing radio contact.
facts.sourceQuote: Quelques minutes après le décollage, le commandant de bord avait signalé une panne sur l'un des deux moteurs et tenté de se dérouter vers l'aérodrome de Walikale avant que tout contact radio ne soit perdu, selon des informations rapportées par Radio Okapi.

facts.claim: Search operations launched on Friday; according to Tracep Congo Aviation sources, the co-pilot was found alive Sunday in the crash zone while the captain died.
facts.sourceQuote: Des opérations de recherche avaient été engagées dès vendredi. Selon des sources de Tracep Congo Aviation, le copilote a été retrouvé vivant dimanche dans la zone du crash, tandis que le commandant de bord a perdu la vie.

facts.claim: Local authorities in Shabunda said the aircraft was expected at Tchonka-Lulingu but never arrived, and confirmed that after reporting an engine problem about twenty minutes after takeoff from Beni, the crew became unreachable.
facts.sourceQuote: À Shabunda, des autorités locales ont indiqué que l'appareil, attendu à Tchonka-Lulingu, n'était jamais arrivé à destination. Elles ont également confirmé qu'après avoir signalé une panne moteur environ vingt minutes après son décollage de Beni, l'équipage était devenu injoignable.
